resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register gives Transylvania County, North Carolina. The Forest Lookouts listing gives Haywood County, and the tnlandforms.us NC tower list also gives Haywood. The record keeps the Register's Transylvania County; the conflict is not resolved.

notes_for_editor: Height (70 ft), 1941 build year and 5,340 ft elevation agree across the Register, Conserving Carolina and the NPS; the metric height of 21.3 m is converted from 70 ft. The county is disputed: the record's Transylvania matches the Register only, while the Forest Lookouts listing and tnlandforms.us (NCT069, Haywood) say Haywood; the record was not changed. The NPS calls the tower 'Frying Pan Fire Tower' and the record uses 'Fryingpan Mountain Lookout'; both names are in use. The NHLR page says 'now used as a radio relay point', which is the only source for current use. The 1990 staffing year is approximate ('early 1990s'). The NPS page has a photo credit ('U.S. Forest Service Photo / Steve Norman') but gives no image URL, so no photo entry is recorded. The Forest Lookouts page is a long index, but the only Fryingpan detail it shows is the county heading.
